articles.title: Gen Z shows low cybersecurity awareness, Kaspersky study finds
articles.description: A Kaspersky study of 7,200 respondents across 18 countries highlights that only 27% of Gen Z use mobile antivirus software, and a mere 28% regularly back up their phone data.
